title: terminalis neocaledonica
intro: Terminalis neocaledonica, commonly known as the "Queen's Flower", is a flowering plant native to the island of New Caledonia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory health. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve anxiety and stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Terminalis neocaledonica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
